title: Ghostbusters

credits.role: design; the only name the game itself shows

credits.by: Garry Kitchen, Dan Kitchen and Alex DeMeo

tools.host: Linux 6.18 x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04 cloud container with four cores and no display
tools.widget tests: node 22.22.2: the page's routines checked against the game's own code in kit/c64/machine.js on snapshots
tools.subagents: annotation agents on disjoint address ranges and, for the Play tab, five porting agents on disjoint routine groups; all claude-opus-5-5
tools.play tab: kit 0.0.38: the game's routines ported to JavaScript in five groups, checked in lockstep against the game's own code in kit/c64/machine.js (57 sessions, 88,550 passes with every group, node 22.22.2), paced by the median cycles per game state measured on the same machine

exclude: the video bank's screens and graphics: the start-up at $6000 clears all of it and builds it again, so the bytes the one-load image carries there are the conversion's leftovers
